title: A customer with incomplete details still moves
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Create a new term of the shop's own for this test, term A, due 20 days after the invoice date.
  • Create customer A for this test on term A, with no address on its record (a detail Edit Customer requires).
  • Make sure Net 45 is active.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  5. Open customer A's customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Move Customers from term A" opens.

Step 3:

  • The button is enabled.

Step 4:

  • The toast "1 customer moved to Net 45." shows and no error appears.

Step 5:

  • "Credit term" reads Net 45.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R12: “Each moved customer gets the new term (and, under S4-R16, a $0 credit limit) and the S4-R11 note. AccountingHub receives the same customer update an Edit Customer save sends. The customer's other fields are not re-checked, so a customer with incomplete details still moves. No customer update is sent to QuickBooks (S8-R6).”
